data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Firebase Remote Config API
data.what_it_does: Allows updating application look, feel, and behavior without re-releasing the app by fetching configurations from Firebase servers.
use_when: You need to change app behavior or UI configuration remotely on the fly
You are already using Firebase in your Flutter application
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase as a backend service
strengths: Official Firebase plugin supported by FlutterFire
Enables feature flags and remote parameter updates without app store updates
weaknesses: Requires proper Firebase project setup and configuration on Android and iOS
Dependent on network availability for fetching new remote configurations
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Firebase in your project and following platform-specific configuration guides.

alternatives.name: firebase_core
alternatives.why_pick_it: Required as the foundation for initializing Firebase services.
